samples.summary: "lets storage win again once a write succeeds" cannot distinguish clearing the mirror from re-setting it
samples.evidence: The test makes a failing write (mirror = "exact"), then a successful `setDateFormat("relative")`, clears storage, and asserts `getDateFormat() === DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT` (= "relative"). Because the last written value is the same as the default, the assertion holds both when `setDateFormat` clears `memoryFormat = null` (src/lib/date-format-preference.ts:66) and under the plausible mutation `memoryFormat = format` on success — the mirror would then hold "relative", which equals the default. The documented invariant ("a stale mirror must not outvote a key another tab cleared") is therefore only half covered; writing "exact" successfully and then clearing storage would actually test it.

samples.summary: New DateCell component (preference-driven text + full date/time tooltip) has no test
samples.evidence: `DateCell` is the entire user-visible wiring introduced by this change: it calls `useDateFormat()`, renders `formatListDate(value, format)` and puts `formatFullDateTime(value)` in the `title` attribute. Only the pure helpers are unit-tested (tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts) and the hook is tested in isolation (tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts); nothing asserts the cell reads the preference, re-renders when it changes, or carries the tooltip. Grepping tests/ for `DateCell`, `useDateFormat`, `formatFullDateTime`, `document-list`, and globbing `**/*.spec.{ts,tsx}` (no frontend browser specs exist) found no covering test.

samples.summary: New Settings date-format Select has no test
samples.evidence: The Settings page gains a `Select` whose `onValueChange` casts an arbitrary string to `DateDisplayFormat` and calls `setDateFormat`, plus sample labels rendered from `formatRelativeTime`/`formatExactDate`. No test file for `src/app/settings/page.tsx` exists anywhere under packages/frontend/tests (grepped for `Settings` and `settings/page`; only the preference module and theme-provider tests matched), so the control's wiring to the store is unverified.

`formatExactDate("2026-07-25T12:00:00.000Z", now)` is asserted to `toMatch(/25/)`, but the UTC instant is rendered in the runtime's local timezone; at offsets of +13/-12 the rendered day is 26/24 and the assertion fails or passes for the wrong reason. The sibling December test (line 138) deliberately builds local-time dates for exactly this reason; this one does not.

samples.summary: formatListDate's `now` forwarding is not actually verified
samples.evidence: "renders an exact date for the exact format" passes `now = 2026-08-12` and asserts the output matches /2025/. Since the real wall clock is also 2026, the same assertion holds if `formatListDate` dropped the `now` argument entirely. A same-year date with an injected `now` in a different year would be needed to prove the parameter is threaded through.

`useSyncExternalStore`'s third argument returns `DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT`; the new test file only renders in jsdom via `renderHook`, which never invokes the server snapshot. Low impact for a Vite SPA, noted for completeness.

finding.summary: New `DateCell` component (preference-driven text + `title` tooltip) has no test at all
finding.evidence: `DateCell` is the whole point of the feature in the list: it calls `useDateFormat()`, renders `formatListDate(value, format)` and sets `title={formatFullDateTime(value)}` (document-list.tsx:240-247). The added tests only cover the pure helpers (tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts) and the store (tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts). Nothing renders `DateCell` or `dateColumn`'s cell, so the acceptance criterion "both columns carry a `title` tooltip with the full localized date+time in every format" is unverified — swapping the two formatters, dropping `title=`, or passing the wrong value would leave the suite green. The frontend also has no `tsc` lane, so a wrong prop wouldn't be caught elsewhere either. Searched: tests/app/documents/ contains only document-list-utils.test.ts and tab-name.test.ts; grep for `DateCell`/`document-list` across packages/frontend returns no test file.

verdict.reason: Verified the claim independently. `DateCell` at packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-list.tsx:240-247 is a non-exported component that calls `useDateFormat()`, renders `formatListDate(value, format)` and sets `title={formatFullDateTime(value)}`; it is used at line 269 as `dateColumn`'s cell. It can therefore only be covered by rendering `DocumentList`, and nothing does: repo-wide grep for `DateCell` yields only the source file and a task doc; grep for `formatListDate|formatFullDateTime|useDateFormat` yields only tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts (pure helpers, lines 155-188) and tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts (store/hook via renderHook, never inside a cell). I searched beyond the reviewer's paths: the co-located suites under packages/frontend/src/app/documents/__tests__/ and all src/**/*.test.* files (grep for "app/documents" in every *.test.* file returns only document-list-utils and tab-name), and there are no e2e/playwright/cypress/integration roots. `DocumentList` itself is only rendered by src/app/documents/page.tsx:67 and src/app/workspaces/workspace-documents.tsx:71, neither under test; grep for getByTitle/title= in frontend tests hits only an unrelated generic-file-view test. So the cell wiring — which formatter feeds the visible text vs. the tooltip, and that a `title` is set at all — is untested: swapping the two formatters or deleting `title=` would keep the suite green. Under the test-adequacy rubric this is a real behavior change with no meaningful test (major); no counterexample exists to refute it.
